item.title: Nanyang Coffee: The Singapore Kopitiam Tradition, Wok-Roast Method & Authentic Kopi Recipes
item.description: Nanyang coffee is the Singapore-Malaysian kopitiam tradition of wok-roasting Robusta and Liberica beans with margarine and caramelized sugar, brewed strong through a sock filter and served with sweetened condensed milk or evaporated milk. Full origin, the wok-roast method, the kopi/kopi-O/kopi-C vocabulary, an authentic home recipe, and how Nanyang differs from Ipoh white coffee and Western specialty coffee.
